title: Migrate state graph and resume source root
summary: Move derived state, graph rebuild, lint, status/task context artifacts, prompt/resume context, status dock prefs, and codewiki_state/codewiki_resume_context tool execution into src/state/**.

goal.outcome: Derived state, graph/rebuild/lint, prompt, and resume-context ownership live under src/state/** while codewiki_state/codewiki_resume_context behavior remains unchanged.
acceptance: Create src/state/** owner modules for state types, generated artifact loading, state builders, graph building/rebuilding, lint report generation, rebuild locking helpers, status dock prefs, prompt rendering, resume context assembly, and codewiki_state/codewiki_resume_context tool execution.
Treat resume-context and prompt as state-owned derived context packets, not a separate src/resume/** root.
Update adapters, UI commands, scripts, tests, and package smoke to import state/graph/resume behavior from src/state/** or stable public API paths.
Remove old state/graph/resume owner paths or retain only explicit temporary shims with TASK-specific tests.

Preserve codewiki_state and codewiki_resume_context schemas/results, graph JSON schema, generated task context shape, lint/audit outputs, status panel behavior, package loading, direct Node execution, and smoke/feature coverage.
Add TASK-specific guard proving legacy state/graph/resume imports are gone or explicitly shimmed.
non_goals: Do not migrate project, knowledge, roadmap, session, GC, change/diff-table, adapters/UI, or skills beyond state consumer import updates.
Do not introduce src/resume/** unless a new decision row approves it; resume/prompt stays under src/state/**.
Do not change generated graph/state schemas, roadmap task context schema, audit profile names, package metadata, or public tool behavior.

delta.desired: Derived state, graph/rebuild/lint, prompt/resume context, status dock prefs, and state tool execution live under src/state/** while public behavior and generated schemas stay stable.
delta.current: Implementation moved owner modules to src/state/** and removed old state/graph/resume owner paths without shims; validation pending.
delta.closure: Close after implementation build, fresh implementation validation, clean commit/tree proof, task-close validation, and post-commit audits.
